QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredPx4MajorVersion
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minimum base firmware major version reported by the autopilot. Set all version fields to zero to disable this check.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required base firmware major

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredPx4MinorVersion
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minimum base firmware minor version when the reported major version matches the required major version.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required base firmware minor

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredPx4PatchVersion
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Minimum base firmware patch version when the reported major and minor versions match the required values.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required base firmware patch

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredStratumSchemaMajor
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Required STRATUM NX schema major version
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The schema major reported in AUTOPILOT_VERSION custom_version must exactly match this value.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required STRATUM schema major

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: requiredStratumNxMajor
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Required STRATUM NX firmware major version
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: The NX firmware major reported in AUTOPILOT_VERSION custom_version must be at least this value.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Required STRATUM NX major

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: strictCompatibilityGate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Show operator warning for firmware mismatch
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Incompatible base/NX firmware is disconnected either way. When enabled, the mismatch also produces an operator-visible warning; when disabled, it is recorded in the log only.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Show strict firmware warning

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: trackerBoxSizePx
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Default click tracker box size in pixels
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: When the operator single-clicks on the video, this fixed-size box is centered at the click point and sent to the trackers.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Tracker click box size

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: c12GimbalMaxSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Upper bound for drag-derived C12 yaw/pitch speed commands. Units are protocol speed units (0.5 deg/s per unit).
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: C12 max gimbal speed

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: passwordHashOverride
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: SHA-256 hex of the admin password set at runtime from the hidden admin dialog. Empty means use the compile-time hash.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Password hash override
